The key is the model

Turning innovation into real-world application



What is Tumor Model Days?

Advances in tumor modeling are expanding opportunities for research and drug development. Tumor Model Days is a marketplace focused on business matchmaking and collaboration, connecting tumor model providers, technology developers, and end users from academia and industry. It brings together organizations looking to offer, source, license, or develop tumor models and related solutions, fostering practical applications, partnerships, and business collaboration across the following core marketplace themes:

Ready-to-Use Tumor Models

Ready-to-use in vitro, ex vivo, and in vivo tumor models available for purchase or licensing, covering a range of model types and research applications.

Tumor Model Libraries & Collections

Tumor model panels, curated collections, and model biobanks available for purchase, licensing, or access, spanning cancer types, disease subtypes, and molecular profiles.

Modeling Technologies & Platforms

Technologies and platforms for generating, engineering, and standardizing tumor models, available for adoption, licensing, or collaborative development.

Supporting Products & Services

Specialized products and services supporting tumor model production, culture, quality control, preservation, and supply.

Special Focus: Custom Tumor Modeling Services

This session focuses on custom tumor modeling for specific research needs, including in vitro, ex vivo, and in vivo model development, contract R&D, and services for model engineering, characterization, and validation.

Products:
Innovation, emerging trends, and market developments.
Technologies:
Scientific advances and emerging approaches.
Applications:
Turn research advances into reliable solutions for real-world needs.
Connections:
Bring researchers, industry, and diverse perspectives together.
